ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Photography
ns2:course.description: Advanced study of photographic issues and the creative process. Discusses creativity, aesthetics, criticism, and current imagery, as well as photography's relationship to other media. Specific topics of focus will vary. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Credit is not given for ARTS 394 if credit for ARTD 393 has been earned. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Photography concentration, or consent of instructor.
